title: Search: a list of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in at most two with at most one NOT gate and at most 38 gates computing the 13 line-ORs of the plane of order 3
statement: ∃ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin 13 → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∃ ι : Fin 1 → Fin gates.length, ∀ i : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → ∃ j : Fin 1, ι j = i) ∧ gates.length ≤ 38 ∧ (∀ (w : Fin 13) (x : Fin 13 → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ (({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)).image (fun u => u + w)), x v = true))
unlocks: The first instance of whether one NOT gate saves anything on the line functions of a plane
context: SKETCH: Encode the 13 line functions of the plane of order 3 as a search: one-hot operand choices over earlier wires, an operation selector, at most one NOT gate, one Boolean per gate and input row; with the NOT gate at position p the wires before it are monotone, which cuts the search. First case: a non-monotone wire doing part of one line's OR. The two rows are a pair; one is true. In-house: nothing below the plain size in any decided case (computed, not checked). Data lane. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
